cohort: 30 neonates clinically diagnosed with HIE (21 preterm, 9 full-term) referred for imaging evaluation.
finding: Both transcranial ultrasound (TCUS) and MRI are useful for diagnosing HIE in neonates, but TCUS had higher sensitivity (100% overall, 64.3% in full-term, 81.3% in preterm) while MRI had higher specificity (100%).
gest_age: Preterm and full-term neonates (within the first 7 days of life)
